the Feedback button on the rail: what goes with it, can't be sent empty, sent with the screen's name, closes with a thank-you

a Google Doc, Sheet and deck open in Timmy's editors as the Word, Excel and PowerPoint files Google exports, and Office and PDF files kept in Drive as they are, with Drive's version; a file shared to view only opens but can't be saved; only a file on the workspace's list; Save replaces the Drive file's content through the gateway (file.update) with the person's press as the approval, audited, and a second save goes on from the new version; a change made in Drive meanwhile stops the save until the person saves over it on purpose; bytes of the wrong kind, someone else's upload, a role that can't make changes and the off switch are refused; a refusal leaves the file alone and a lost answer is never called a success; the read-only guard still refuses the write tool to anything but the executor; OneDrive opens to read only
